name: form-field
purpose: Gives a consumer-owned native <input>, <textarea>, or <select> the AbsoluteUI field chrome and validation: label, required indicator, help text, localized messages mapped from the browser's ValidityState, the shared message timing, and Form integration. The control element stays the consumer's; only its ARIA wiring and the surrounding chrome are managed.
whenToUse: Native controls AbsoluteUI does not render itself: type=number, text-like input types (text, email, url, tel, search, password), a native <select> or <select multiple>, or a <textarea> with native attributes.
Progressive enhancement of server-rendered inputs that must keep their element and attributes.
Making a plain native element take part in Form validation and the error summary.
whenNotToUse: Text entry with counters, addons, or password reveal: use Text Input or Textarea.
Checkboxes, radios, and switches: use Checkbox, Radio Group, or Switch (Form Field rejects them).
Date and time values: use Date Input, Date Picker, or Time Picker (date, time, datetime-local, month, and week inputs are rejected).
Range sliders and color pickers: range and color inputs are rejected.
responsive: The control fills its container (inline-size 100%, min-inline-size 0). Textareas resize vertically. A <select> keeps its native picker; only the closed control is styled.
rtl: Follows the document direction; the chrome uses logical properties.
theme: Control surface, border, focus, error, disabled, and sunken-surface role tokens through the shared control-surface and text-control-states mixins. Forced-colors mode draws a Highlight outline on focus.
security: Label, help text, and messages are rendered with textContent. Validation messages never include the entered value, only constraint parameters. The consumer's control is not cloned or re-created. CSP-safe.
dataHandling: No persistence, network access, or telemetry. The native control carries its own value for form submission.

budgets.budget: No dedicated performance test; one render per input/change/blur event

performance.testedScale: Unit tests cover single fields of each supported element type.

limitations: Constraint attributes are read on each render; after changing attributes or the value in code, call refresh().
The initial value for dirty and reset() is captured at creation.
No character counter; use Text Input or Textarea for that.
unsupported: checkbox, radio, file, hidden, button, submit, reset, image, date, time, datetime-local, month, week, range, and color inputs (rejected with FORM_FIELD_OPTIONS).
Wrapping more than one control in one field.
Rendering HTML in the label, help text, or messages.
antiPatterns: Adding a separate <label> for the control; Form Field renders the label.
Relying on native validation bubbles; they are suppressed.
Changing constraint attributes in code without calling refresh().

adapters.angular: @absoluteui/angular/form-field: AuiFormField directive ([auiFormField]) wrapping a native control inside its host; the control keeps Angular's own value accessor.
